title: Search database load spike
summary: search-api database load and latency spiked after a cache configuration rollout

runbooks.title: Cache hit-rate collapse
runbooks.content: When cache hit rate collapses while traffic is stable, inspect capacity and eviction configuration. Restore safe capacity and warm the cache while protecting the database.

oracle.root_cause: The cache rollout reduced maxmemory from 4GB to 256MB, causing heavy eviction, an 8% hit rate, and excessive database load.
remediation: Protect the database with load shedding
